{{Quote|I had a wife. She's gone&hellip;recently gone.''"<br />"''I'm sorry for you&hellip;but I'm not sorry ''she's gone''. This would be far more ''complicated'' if she were here.|King Caled Galfridian and the Yuuzhan Vong Nina Galfridian|<ref name="Invasion4" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual was the '''first wife''' of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Caled Galfridian]], the [[King/Legends|king]] of the<ref name="Invasion4" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="InvasionPrelude">[[Invasion 0|''Invasion'' 0]]</ref> [[Artorias]] and the leader of the royal [[Galfridian family]]. She gave [[Reproduction/Legends|birth]] to two children, [[Finn Galfridian|Finn]] and [[Kaye Galfridian]].<ref name="Invasion4" /> Shortly after his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] [[Death/Legends|died]]<ref name="Invasion4" /> by [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> the king was angered by her death and began to hunt down those he considered evil. While doing so, he married<ref name="Invasion4" /> the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]<ref name="Revelations">[[Invasion: Revelations 5|''Invasion: Revelations'' 5]]</ref> [[Nina Galfridian]]. Nina thought that her relationship with the king would be more complicated if his first wife had not died.<ref name="Invasion4" />

==Behind the scenes==
Caled Galfridian's first wife was mentioned in the [[Invasion: Rescues 4|ninth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Invasion]]'' comic series, which was published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="Invasion4" /> on [[September 29]], [[2010]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54259/star_wars_invasion_-_rescues_2010_4|text=Star Wars: Invasion - Rescues (2010) #4}}</ref> The issue was written by [[Tom Taylor]] and illustrated by [[Colin Wilson]].<ref name="Invasion4" />
